entries.knownHazards: Products containing rosemary oil may cause erythema (redness) of the skin. Caution needed if allergies. Reportedly used as an abortifacient in large quantities but can lead to deep coma, spasm and vomiting and even death [301].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Rozmarino aliejus dirgina odą ir gali sukelti eritemas; alergikams — atsargiai. Dideliais kiekiais toksiškas: sukelia spazmą, vėmimą ir komą, išskirtiniais atvejais — mirtinas; nenaudoti nėštumo metu.

entries.knownHazards: The berries are purgative[8]. Caution required if used in patients on treatment for high blood pressure. An increase in tone of veins can influence blood pressure allowing more blood to flow to the heart [301].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Uogos turi vidurius laisvinantį poveikį. Didina venų tonusą ir kraujospūdį — atsargiai vartoti kartu su vaistais nuo hipertenzijos.

entries.knownHazards: All parts of this plant are poisonous in large quantities[19]. It should not be used at all by pregnant women since it can induce abortions[165]. The sap contains furanocoumarins, sensitizing the skin to light and causing blistering or dermatitis in sensitive people[200].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Didelėmis dozėmis visos dalys toksiškos; draudžiama nėščiosioms — sukelia abortą. Syvai turi furanocoumarinų, kurie jautrių žmonių odą sensibilizuoja šviesai ir sukelia pūsles arba dermatitą.

entries.knownHazards: Gastrointestinal bleeding & kidney damage possible. Avoid concurrent administration with other aspirin-like drugs. Avoid during pregnancy. Drug interactions associated with salicylates applicable [301].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Salicilatai gali sukelti virškinamojo trakto kraujavimą ir inkstų pažeidimą. Nevartoti kartu su aspirinu ar kitais salicilatais, taip pat nėštumo metu.

entries.knownHazards: The plant can be toxic when used in excess or when taken for extended periods[238] symptoms include: restlessness, vomiting, vertigo, tremors, seizures. Contraindicated during pregnancy. Avoid if predisposed to convulsions [301].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Ilgai ar perteklinai vartojamas toksiškas: sukelia nerimą, vėmimą, galvos svaigimą, tremorus ir traukulius. Draudžiamas nėštumo metu ir asmenims, linkusiems į konvulsijas.

entries.knownHazards: Although no specific mention has been seen for this species, the leaves and stems of some members of this genus are poisonous[9, 76]. The fruit of many species (although no records have been seen for this species) has been known to cause stomach upsets to some people. Any toxin the fruit might contain is liable to be of very low toxicity and is destroyed when the fruit is cooked[65, 76].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Lapai ir stiebai gali būti toksiški. Vaisiai gali dirginti skrandį, tačiau virimo metu toksinai sunaikinami.

entries.knownHazards: The leaves and stems of this species are poisonous[9, 76]. The fruit has been known to cause stomach upsets to some people[65, 76]. The unripe fruit contains a toxic alkaloid and cyanogenic glycosides[274]. Any toxin the fruit might contain is liable to be of very low toxicity and is destroyed when the fruit is cooked[65, 76].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Lapai ir stiebai toksiški. Nesubrendę vaisiai turi alkaloidų ir cianogeninių glikozidų, tačiau virinant toksinai sunaikinami; prinokę vaisiai retkarčiais dirgina skrandį.

entries.knownHazards: Although no specific mention has been seen for this species, the leaves and stems of some, if not all, members of this genus are poisonous[9, 76]. The fruit of many species (although no records have been seen for this species) has been known to cause stomach upsets to some people. Any toxin the fruit might contain is liable to be of very low toxicity and is destroyed when the fruit is cooked[65, 76]. NC State University have noted Cyanogenic glycoside and alkaloids can cause low toxity if eaten.
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Lapai ir stiebai tikėtinai toksiški. Vaisiai turi cianogeninių glikozidų ir alkaloidų, tačiau virinant toksinai sunaikinami; prinokę vaisiai gali dirginti skrandį.

entries.knownHazards: This species contains many alkaloids and is poisonous in large doses[4, 21, 46, 165]. This herb should not be used by women when they are pregnant or lactating[165]. The sap, fresh or dried, can cause intense irritation to the mucous membranes[169].
entries.knownHazardsLtV2: Turi daug alkaloidų — didelėmis dozėmis toksiškas; draudžiama nėščiosioms ir žindančioms moterims. Šviežias arba džiovintas syvai stipriai dirgina gleivinę.
